# Public Assets

This directory hosts static assets served at the root path.

## Mascot Assets

Place Archie mascot Lottie JSON or SVG assets here. They will be served at:

- `/archie-idle.json`
- `/archie-focus.json`
- `/archie-success.json`
- `/archie-warning.json`

The `ArchieMascot` component currently renders an inline SVG for each state, but can be extended to load Lottie animations from these files.
